name: AI News Daily
audience: People who follow tech and AI (developers, students, founders, curious professionals, India and worldwide) and want one short daily catch-up of what actually happened in the last 24 hours
titleFormula: AI & Tech News: What Happened in the Last 24 Hours | <D Mon YYYY> | <2-3 biggest names or stories>
titleExamples: AI & Tech News: What Happened in the Last 24 Hours | 14 Oct 2026 | OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
notes: Daily tech + AI news roundup, English, neutral male narrator (built-in TTS speaker). Tone: calm, fast, factual news anchor; no hype words, no 'guys'. CTA: one comment question + subscribe for tomorrow's roundup. The channel name is a placeholder until the owner decides: change name/shortName here and in config/daily.json's brief. Intro is used only when the file exists in Drive.
